observation.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/s2.log
setsid nohup just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero > /tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:45423/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "cms UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "cms direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:45423/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
